observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains each footwork pattern clearly from a front-facing perspective, demonstrating slow breakdowns before speeding up. He emphasizes weight distribution and posture while guiding viewers through counts.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to five easy footwork shuffle steps.
Step 1: Criss Cross explanation and slow practice.
Step 2: Heel Toe explanation and practice.

common_mistakes: Weight shifting too much to one side instead of staying in the middle
safety: Make sure your body is in the middle between the two legs for better balance and control

steps_taught.name: Criss Cross
steps_taught.description: Crossing feet alternately while keeping weight centered.

steps_taught.name: Heel Toe
steps_taught.description: Pivoting on heels and toes to open and close feet.

steps_taught.name: W-Step
steps_taught.description: Combining criss cross and heel toe movements.

what_works: Breaking down steps into slow and fast tempos
Clear focus on weight distribution and posture
what_hinders: Fast pace of shuffle steps might be challenging for complete beginners without practice

quotes.text: Today we'll learn five of the most easiest footwork shuffle steps.
We'll need to balance our weight properly, so make sure your body is exactly in the middle.
One important thing that you need to know about footwork is that you can do them hopping.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates Criss Cross footwork slowly facing forward.
Instructor demonstrates heel and toe pivoting motions.

extraction.distinctive_method: Explaining weight distribution using an imaginary vertical centerline between the legs.
